F2_identifier_and_path_confinement.frozen_grammar: content IDs (chunk sha256 and manifest_id path arguments) must match ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ exactly
frozen_rules: chunk_path(root, sha) raises ArchiveError unless sha is exactly 64 lowercase hex
manifest_path(root, manifest_id) raises ArchiveError unless manifest_id is exactly 64 lowercase hex
load_manifest(root, manifest_id) raises ManifestValidationError unless validated body manifest_id == requested manifest_id (filename/body binding)

path confinement: the resolved absolute target of chunk_path/manifest_path and the caller-visible read/write targets must remain strictly below Path(root).resolve(); verified before ANY filesystem read or write in write_chunk/publish_manifest/load_manifest/verify_chunk paths
failure mode: fail closed BEFORE any filesystem access outside root; explicit ArchiveError or ManifestValidationError, never a silent fallback
verify_chunk with a malicious ID returns a report whose errors include the grammar/conf confinement failure, or raises ArchiveError per the frozen rule (A2 freezes which, tests pin it)
valid historical 64-hex IDs remain byte-compatible: the V1 layout <root>/chunks/<h2>/<h2b>/<sha256>.jsonl and <root>/manifests/<id>.json is unchanged for valid IDs
mandatory_negative_tests: empty, short (<64), 63/65-length, uppercase, non-hex and overlong IDs rejected for chunk and manifest paths
'../' traversal, absolute path, separator and encoded/pathlike variants rejected
valid manifest bytes stored under a different valid 64-hex filename: load_manifest fails closed (filename/body mismatch)
symlink escape at a chunk directory boundary and at the manifest directory boundary: target resolves outside root -> fail closed before read/write
verify_chunk with a malicious ID: visible failure, no filesystem write
replay with a malicious or filename/body-mismatched manifest ID: fail closed (CorruptReplayInput or ReplayInputError family), never silent acceptance
all pre-existing valid-ID archive fixtures still pass byte-identically (no historical fixture changes)
